Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Premature Assumption of Task Completion based on Incomplete and Contradictory Data

The Planner made a critical error in Step 4 by concluding the task and asserting the answer was "Left-handed" despite having clear evidence to the contrary. 

In Step 3, the WebSurfer successfully retrieved search results from multiple reliable sources (All Out Cricket, CREX, Cricket.com.au, CricClubs) that explicitly stated Wahab Riaz's batting style as "Right Hand Bat" or "Right Handed". However, the Planner ignored this definitive data. Instead, the Planner relied on an inference from the BBC article (which described him as a "left-arm fast bowler") to incorrectly assume he was a left-handed batsman. 

This is a classic case of "Premature Assumption of Task Completion" (as seen in Example 5). The Planner failed to reconcile the conflicting information (Left-arm bowling vs. Right-hand batting) and ignored the explicit "Right-hand bat" data provided by the WebSurfer in the previous step, leading to an incorrect final answer.
